SELECT from_account_id::text AS hot FROM transfers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT now() AS at, relpages, relallvisible, reltuples::bigint AS reltuples FROM pg_class WHERE relname='transfers'
SELECT now() AS at, n_live_tup, vacuum_count, autovacuum_count, analyze_count, autoanalyze_count, last_autovacuum, last_autoanalyze FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE relname='transfers'
SELECT count(*)::int AS hot_rows FROM transfers WHERE from_account_id = '{{HOT}}'

EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, COSTS OFF, TIMING OFF) WITH w AS (SELECT created_at, amount, to_account_id FROM v_transfer_facts WHERE from_account_id = '{{HOT}}' AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND type = 'TRANSFER' AND created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND created_at < now() + interval '1 ms') SELECT agg.n, (agg.amounts[(agg.n + 1) / 2]::numeric + agg.amounts[(agg.n + 2) / 2]::numeric)::text AS median2, agg.hour, agg.ten, agg.recipients, agg.total, agg.small, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v_transfer_facts WHERE id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009' AND from_account_id = '{{HOT}}' AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND type = 'TRANSFER' AND created_at >= now() - interval '1 hour' AND created_at < now() + interval '1 ms') AS cur FROM (SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at < now()))::int AS n, array_agg(amount ORDER BY amount) FILTER (WHERE created_at < now()) AS amounts, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '1 hour'))::int AS hour, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '10 minutes'))::int AS ten, (count(DISTINCT to_account_id) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'))::int AS recipients, COALESCE(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'), 0)::text AS total, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' AND amount::numeric * 10 < 500000000::numeric))::int AS small FROM w) agg

EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, COSTS OFF, TIMING OFF) SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM (SELECT w.to_account_id AS recipient FROM (SELECT to_account_id, min(created_at) AS first_at FROM v_transfer_facts WHERE from_account_id = '{{HOT}}' AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND type = 'TRANSFER' AND created_at >= now() - interval '1 hour' AND created_at < now() + interval '1 ms' GROUP BY to_account_id) w WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v_transfer_facts p WHERE p.from_account_id = '{{HOT}}' AND p.to_account_id = w.to_account_id AND p.status = 'COMPLETED' AND p.type = 'TRANSFER' AND p.created_at >= date_trunc('milliseconds', w.first_at) - interval '30 days' AND p.created_at < date_trunc('milliseconds', w.first_at))) recipients
